markscheme.html:
1a

 

The kinetic energy of the stone is converted into the gravitational potential energy of the stone.

 

1b

 

Kinetic energy of the stone when it reaches the ground = Gravitational potential energy of the stone at the top of the cliff + Kinetic energy of the stone at the top of the cliff = J

Kinetic energy of the stone when it loses contact with the ground after the bounce = Total energy of the stone when it reaches its maximum height after the bounce = J

Energy transferred to the Earth: J

Percentage of kinetic energy transferred to ground: % %

 

1c

 

W

question.html:
A stone is thrown horizontally from the top of a cliff with an initial speed of m s. The vertical height of the cliff is m. The mass of the stone is kg. Air resistance is negligible.

Upon reaching the ground, the stone bounces and reaches a maximum height of m. The stone is in contact with the ground for ms. The horizontal speed of the stone at the highest point of its motion after the bounce is m s.

a. Outline the energy changes of the stone between the moment when it loses contact with the ground after the bounce and the moment when it reaches its maximum height.

   [1 mark]

b. Find what percentage of the stone’s kinetic energy was transferred to the Earth when the stone hit the ground.

   [4 marks]

c. Calculate the power delivered by the stone to the Earth.

   [1 mark]
